flaggedSections.quotedText: "Confidential Information" means any information disclosed by Discloser to Recipient that is marked "Confidential" in writing at the time of disclosure, or, if disclosed orally, is summarized in a writing marked "Confidential" delivered to Recipient within ten (10) days of the oral disclosure.
flaggedSections.explanation: The clause defines Confidential Information only as information marked 'Confidential' in writing, or orally disclosed information later confirmed in a marked writing (grounded fact). This is materially narrower than the Spaarke standard, which requires a definition broad enough to cover oral, visual, written, electronic, and derived information regardless of marking -- Helios (the disclosing party) risks losing protection for information it discloses informally or forgets to mark (advisory judgment).
